title: Cloud Nurdz Bar Salts Peach Blue Razz Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cloud Nurdz Salts Peach Blue Razz Ice Nic Salt E-liquid combines the juicy sweetness of peach with the tartness of blue raspberry, finished with a refreshing icy touch. This combination creates a balanced and invigorating vape experience, perfect for those who enjoy fruity and cool flavours. Cloud Nurdz Salts e-liquids are crafted with a 50VG/50PG blend, making them perfect for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids provide a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine delivery, making them ideal for adult smokers and vapers seeking effective nicotine relief. They are best used in low-wattage MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as Pod Kits and Starter Kits. Founded in 2016 by two vaping enthusiasts, US vape juice brand Cloud Nurdz is celebrated for its astonishing e-liquid flavours. Their dedication to creating unique and satisfying vape experiences has earned them a loyal following worldwide. Discover the bold range of Cloud Nurdz Salts at Vapestore today.
